notes.title: Work Progress Display(Story Event Adjustment)
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Dear Calamity Administrators：[/b][/h3]

In the forward update, we will improve the importance of “story event”. We are planning to add more context to each story, fortify their character introduction, put more “Easter Egg” and set some secret elements. These will improve the events’ randomness and degree of freedom.

In the future, besides the event in which players can interact on the map, it will contain a new type of event which we called it “triggered event”. This type of event will show up when some special condition has been satisfied, and it will force the Calamity Administrator to choose from the following choices. This mechanic will bring more uncertainty to the whole game.

In the old version, we have many events that have no story like combat events, recovery events, treasure events. We will try to blend these into our new “story event” system. According to players’ choices, they may gain advantage of disadvantages. Also, after a failure lock picking, their treasure perhaps becomes an unwelcome “treasure lady”.

Besides these, we will also improve Calamity Administrators’ influence on the game. The new events will contain a chained storyline. This means Calamity Administrators’ choice will make a further influence. Consequences, right?

In the end, we hope these adjustments will provide Calamity Administrators more fun, reducing the boring by repeating the game and increasing each round’s randomness and feeling of immersion.

notes.title: Words from the developer
notes.notes:
[h3][b]1.Why do we need to adopt the model of "Early Access"?[/b][/h3]
First of all, this is an independent game made with heart. Our team is a group of players who love anime and rogue games. In order to make an ideal game, we put our bold and fun ideas into action and made this game with all our hearts. We have decided to adopt Early Access in order to listen to your ideas and suggestions earlier, and hope that you can participate in the creation of the game.

[h3][b]2.How long will the game's pre-release status last?[/b][/h3]
We hope that this game, through continuous improvement and refinement, will be satisfied and recognized by you. So the creation needs some time to polish it, probably expected to be about half a year. For this reason, we are working hard on the creation and look forward to presenting this piece of product to you in the most perfect form.

[h3][b]3.How much difference is there between the planned full version and the pre-release version?[/b][/h3]
The final game is planned to include:
We will fix the bugs players reported and take their suggestions made during early access. We will improve related values and UI while adding a range of new elements.
1. We are planning to also localize the game in Japanese, Korean, and possibly other languages.
2. Steam stats, achievements, and Workshops will be added.
3. We will perfect the tutorial, the Authority system, and other features.

4. Pioneer Mode will be added based on the current model. This new model will offer a fresh experience, testing players' ability to allocate resources more than ever.
5. Ultra Commands will have cooldowns. Ultimate and Combo will be removed.
6. A fatigue system will be added. Valkyries lose half a star upon deployment, whereas undeployed Valkyries recover half a star per turn.
7. We'll add events that will be compulsorily triggered when a certain condition is met.
8. Event options will be added. Certain options will cost turns. Generated events will become more relevant to the corresponding map tiles.

9. Easter egg events will be added to spice up the game. Completing a certain option of specific events will unlock new Valkyries, Commands, etc.
10. We'll add Command effect previews and improve the UI of Commands, Soul Gear, Emblems, etc. We'll also add smoother UE effects and designs for maximum immersion.
11. Valkyries will be dubbed in Japanese under certain circumstances to make battles even more immersive.
12. More stunning Valkyries will be added, bringing the total number of Valkyries to over 80. Emblems will be increased to 80 and Soul Gear to 100. A wide range of monsters and bosses will be added. Monsters will be increased to 50. Singularity bosses will be increased to 20, special stage bosses to 20, and Final Calamity bosses to 10.

13. We'll add difficulty levels and various in-game events like lotteries, casinos, and special challenges.
14. We'll add a story mode with a complete storyline and multiple endings.
15. A dynamic difficulty system will be added: in Pioneer Mode, players can challenge themselves by customizing the difficulty.
16. A dynamic reward system will be added, granting players various dynamic rewards throughout the game.
17. A gallery will be added, including a story playback function and a bestiary.

[h3][b]4.What is the status of the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
For now, Early Access contains:
1. Full walkthrough of main gameplay which eliminates calamity, and we have one basic difficulty In the full walkthrough, it also contains battle, story event, merchant event, etc. We will focus on these parts to improve their performance.
2. Finished basic outline of authority system.
3. Finished Pioneer(Hero) and its commands.
4. Finished about 30 Valkyries and their soul gears, enable, etc.
5. We have 20 types of monsters, 6 singularity bosses, 2 final bosses, 2 special bosses.
6. Finished tutorial.

[h3][b]5.Will the price of the game be different during and after the Early Access?[/b][/h3]
We consider that the game content and gameplay will be constantly updated and improved, and the development cost will also increase, so the price after the official release, may be adjusted. Or may not, however, we will insist on creating, we are willing to discuss fully with the players and listen to your suggestions, once there is an adjustment, we will be the first to announce the news in advance.


[h3][b]6.How do we plan to involve the player community in the development process?[/b][/h3]
"We plan to communicate with players through various channels such as steam community, Discord, Facebook, Twitter, Reddit, etc., to listen to players' real feelings, suggestions, and feedback as well as expectations of this game. We will further adjust our game according to these suggestions and feedback, and do our best to make this game good"

[h3][b]Cheers,
White knight[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Calamity Administrator
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Calamity Administrator——[/b][/h1]
This is the role of the player in the game, responsible for maintaining the stability of the realm and removing the effects of the " Calamity " on each world. The Calamity Administrator himself does not have the ability to eliminate Calamities directly. Instead, they need to select and guide the Heralds who will descend on the eroded worlds to face the Calamity and destroy it with the help of the Calamity Elimination System.

[h1][b]Heralds——[/b][/h1]
Heralds are "ordinary people" hand-picked by the Calamity Administrator from each world. They will be fed into the shell in the form of data, after which they will be sent to other calamity-infested worlds to solve those headaches. In the Herald's eyes, the Calamity Administrator is a god-like being, and he or she is the god's chosen savior.  Although they occasionally encounter Heralds who are not very cooperative, often the experienced Calamity Administrator will quickly find a way to make them cooperate.
"Want to go home? Go save the world first!"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/eedf4953df5ddd71c69b830118d5b239155656b7.png[/img]


[h1][b]Valkyrie ——[/b][/h1]
Valkyrie is the alias for the Shell after accessing the soul data. They can adapt to any extreme environment. They will faithfully carry out the instructions passed by the Herald and use their respective characteristics to accomplish all seemingly impossible tasks.  They are the Herald's most powerful assistants in the destruction of the Calamity.
Each Valkyrie's personality and memories are related to the soul data loaded, which stores everything about their identity and origins.  When they appear at the Herald's side, they appear in the form of "summoning magic" and identify the Herald as the reason for their descent into the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/9f8a26fa82db18caed712176dff4dd0ee0cd7541.png[/img]


[h1][b]Shell——[/b][/h1]
It was developed and mass-produced by the "Dimensional Management Corporation" as an extremely high-performance material terminal, and was used in large quantities by the Calamity Administrator to eliminate Calamities after loading the Herald system and soul data.  Although the prosthetic body can play an incomparably powerful combat power, to fully stimulate the performance of the prosthetic body, requires countless times of actual combat calculations. This also makes the disaster removal team look a little vulnerable when they first access the body.
The body usually exists in the Etheric Warehouse of the Dimensional Management Corporation. When the Herald needs it, the Calamity Administrator will access the soul data for the body and the Herald will call the Valkyrie to come in the form of a summon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/34a3a868e874e5338a8095dc165814d355f0e0c8.png[/img]


[h1][b]Soul Core——[/b][/h1]
In addition to optimizing the algorithm for continuous combat, you can also install the plug-in "Soul Core" to make the shell more efficient in certain aspects. Proper use of the SoulCore can make up for defects or amplify the advantages, to bring a certain degree of convenience to clear the task.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/de2912d5e749d908055b069884bf925539011c62.png[/img]


[h1][b]Emblem——[/b][/h1]
In addition to the "Soul Core" that can enhance the efficiency of a single Shell, there is also the "Emblem" that can enhance the Herald system to improve the efficiency of the entire team. The more "Emblems" you have, the more you can enhance the Herald system, and the easier the cleaning task will be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/22cad484eea7731503d59d7650fa396b0fed2021.png[/img]


[h1][b]Command ——[/b][/h1]
Instructions are the means given by the Calamity Administrator to the Herald and Valkyrie to control the shell. The use of commands allows the shell to maximize the characteristics of the host. There are three types of commands as follows.
	--[b]Herald Command:[/b] It represents the various abilities carried by the Herald itself. Its rich variety is perfect for various situations.
	--[b]Valkyrie Command: [/b]This is a command unique to the Valkyrie, it represents the powerful abilities that the Valkyrie itself has, and its release can expand your advantages and make up for battle losses.
	[b]--Ultimate Command:[/b] This is an extremely valuable command that can instantly turn the tide of battle, but because of its special nature, the command will delete itself after it is used.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/7a75ddae5bb13e6b5218318de035d0e178de9db0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41191755/fa520ebffbfe1bc6568959423a069e7137266096.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

"Welcome to the company as a new tester; from today, you are the tester of this NO. 5 planet test field!"

At some point in history, a phenomenon called calamity appeared in the universe. Companies with ultra-high-dimensional technology have used this phenomenon, which would have destroyed the planet, to conduct various experiments.

"Don't worry, you don't need to go directly to the field to face these calamities, but through the company's newly developed command-type mimic body for remote control, and test its performance. Of course, you will not be alone with a body to test, there will be other Valkyrie combat-type bodies to support you. Perhaps, your mission will encounter a variety of unexpected situations, regardless of the outcome, they will make you become more like a pro. Now let's go! Even if the body is damaged, it will not cause any impact on you. After all, research itself comes with loss, right?”

"For the sake of the company, or perhaps for your personal future. Work Hard, kiddo!"

"Of course, this place also offers you the opportunity to communicate with each other and various other testers, please enter the communication code [url=]https://discord.gg/bBcXatNxPv[/url] to join the discussion."

Thanks for reading!

White Knight Game
